rules.statement: A person who enters into possession of land under an agreement with the owners to sell the same to him cannot acquire title by prescription after the lapse of ten years, especially if his possession is not adverse to the true owners.
rules.supporting_quote: "On the facts reported I confess that I find it difficult to see how an intending purchaser who is given possession with an agreement that the vendors would convey the land to him when they had perfected their own title can be regarded as a licensee under the vendor."
